Owner ruling 2026-08-25: find out how the field does this, decide whether we created the implementation difficulty ourselves, and if so align to the field's implementation. We did create it. This row replaces a self-invented coverage-ratio family that cannot fail with the field's standard datastore metrics, changes WHAT IS REPORTED and never what is retrieved or decided, changes no knob, rebuilds no snapshot on disk, displaces nothing hash-pinned, revises no landed number, and authorises no flight.
hard_stop: HARD STOP. This row reports; it does not act. No knob is changed, no snapshot is rebuilt on disk, no landed receipt or readiness document is rewritten, no flight or re-flight is authorised, and no number here revises, re-tunes or restates the 2026-08-25 DEV-1000 baseline lock.

metric_definitions.decontamination_intersection: the MEASURED number of eval items found inside the datastore -- by exact sample id, by normalised text and by shared word n-gram -- with the identities of anything that intersects
metric_definitions.gold_recall_curve: recall@k of a gold-bearing content facet, denominated on the EVAL population's queries; a query whose gold is absent from the datastore is a miss at every k and is never removed from the denominator
metric_definitions.scaling_curve: datastore size swept as an axis; every reported quantity is a function of the swept size, and a curve that does not move is refused
metric_definitions.support_distribution: exemplars per TASK target, denominated on the task's target vocabulary, with min / p05 / p25 / p50 / p75 / p95 / max, the count at support 1 and the count at support 0 with identities
